items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: I can't think of... Chani. Oh, Chani. Yeah. ... He was wonderful. He played a great kind of beat for that band.

ctx.x: And it's... You know... Many a truth is said in jazz. That's what Kid René used to say too. Yeah. He used to say... Who was his drummer? You were talking about his drummer.
I can't think of... Chani. Oh, Chani. Yeah.
